caption: Alghero sea walls, Alghero
composition: Catalan medieval ramparts over the harbor · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: The walkway runs along the ramparts at the left of the frame, warm floodlights picking out the honey-colored stone arches and round tower, while the dark sea fills the right and the town's lights glitter along the far shore. Rocky cliffs drop between the wall and the water, and the sky is still deep night blue at 06:01. The lit promenade curving away under the walls gives the whole scene its sweep.
